commands.command: set -eu; git fetch origin; git checkout main; git pull --ff-only origin main; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "c67752483b07ba88399c6e1e6940c33dd3a2f51f"; MODEL=$(adb shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r'); test "$MODEL" = "SM-S906B"; adb shell dumpsys activity services io.blueeye | grep -q 'io.blueeye/.service.ScannerService'; TMP=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$TMP"' EXIT; snapshot(){ P=$1; adb exec-out run-as io.blueeye cat databases/tracker_database > "$TMP/$P.db"; adb exec-out run-as io.blueeye cat databases/tracker_database-wal > "$TMP/$P.db-wal" 2>/dev/null || true; adb exec-out run-as io.blueeye cat databases/tracker_database-shm > "$TMP/$P.db-shm" 2>/dev/null || true; }; snapshot pre; PRE=$(sqlite3 "$TMP/pre.db" 'select coalesce(max(timestamp),0) from signal_samples;'); echo PRE_MAX_TS=$PRE; echo SIGNAL_COLUMNS=$(sqlite3 "$TMP/pre.db" 'pragma table_info(signal_samples);' | cut -d'|' -f2 | paste -sd, -); echo DEVICE_COLUMNS=$(sqlite3 "$TMP/pre.db" 'pragma table_info(devices);' | cut -d'|' -f2 | paste -sd, -); sleep 180; snapshot post; POST=$(sqlite3 "$TMP/post.db" 'select coalesce(max(timestamp),0) from signal_samples;'); echo POST_MAX_TS=$POST; test "$POST" -gt "$PRE"; echo NEW_SIGNAL_SAMPLES=$(sqlite3 "$TMP/post.db" "select count(*) from signal_samples where timestamp>$PRE;"); echo TARGET_SIGNAL_ROWS; sqlite3 -header -separator '|' "$TMP/post.db" "select coalesce(deviceName,'') as name,coalesce(deviceType,'') as type,coalesce(vendorName,'') as vendor,coalesce(beaconType,'') as beacon,count(*) as samples,round(avg(rssi),1) as avgRssi,min(timestamp) as firstTs,max(timestamp) as lastTs from signal_samples where timestamp>$PRE and (lower(coalesce(deviceName,'')) like '%fmdn%' or lower(coalesce(deviceName,'')) like '%gfps%' or lower(coalesce(deviceName,'')) like '%wf-1000xm5%' or lower(coalesce(deviceName,'')) like '%sony%' or lower(coalesce(deviceName,'')) like '%garmin%' or lower(coalesce(deviceName,'')) like '%forerunner%' or lower(coalesce(beaconType,'')) like '%find hub%' or lower(coalesce(serviceDataByUuidHex,'')) like '%feaa%' or lower(coalesce(serviceDataByUuidHex,'')) like '%fe2c%' or manufacturerId=135) group by name,type,vendor,beacon order by samples desc limit 100;"; echo RECENT_TOP; sqlite3 -header -separator '|' "$TMP/post.db" "select coalesce(deviceName,'') as name,coalesce(deviceType,'') as type,coalesce(vendorName,'') as vendor,coalesce(beaconType,'') as beacon,count(*) as samples,round(avg(rssi),1) as avgRssi,min(timestamp) as firstTs,max(timestamp) as lastTs from signal_samples where timestamp>$PRE group by name,type,vendor,beacon order by samples desc limit 40;"; echo TRACKER_RAW_PREFIXES; sqlite3 -header -separator '|' "$TMP/post.db" "select coalesce(deviceName,'') as name,coalesce(deviceType,'') as type,coalesce(beaconType,'') as beacon,rssi,substr(coalesce(serviceDataByUuidHex,''),1,180) as serviceData,timestamp from signal_samples where timestamp>$PRE and (lower(coalesce(beaconType,'')) like '%find hub%' or lower(coalesce(deviceName,'')) like '%fmdn%' or lower(coalesce(deviceName,'')) like '%gfps%' or lower(coalesce(serviceDataByUuidHex,'')) like '%feaa%' or lower(coalesce(serviceDataByUuidHex,'')) like '%fe2c%') order by timestamp desc limit 30;"
